newsitem.title: VATICAN: Pope holds first general audience since surgery.
newsitem.headline: Pope holds first general audience since surgery.

text.p: Pope John Paul on Wednesday held his first general audience since undergoing an appendectomy last month.

Seated as usual in a big white chair on the stage of the Vatican audience hall, the Pope read his religious message in several languages and greeted pilgrims without apparent difficulty during the 75-minute appearance.

The 76-year-old Pope has eased back into his full schedule of activities since returning to the Vatican on October 15 following a 10-day stay at Rome's Gemelli Hospital for surgery to remove his appendix.

He is scheduled to lead evening prayers on Thursday and to celebrate mass at St Peter's Basilica on Sunday as part of continuing celebrations of the 50th anniversary of his ordination as a priest on November 1, 1946.
